title: A Bad Trainee Nun
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 19.19 Linked Discourses 19.19
  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Pāpasikkhamānasutta A Bad Trainee Nun

“Addasaṁ sikkhamānaṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantiṁ. “I saw a trainee nun flying through the air. Tassā saṅghāṭipi ādittā …pe… Her outer robe was burning …” …

pāpasikkhamānā ahosi …pe…. “She used to be a bad trainee nun …”

Navamaṁ.
